verdict.rationale: Paxos documents a transaction-reconciliation capability, USD settlement to a bank, and a List Transfers API with filtering and paging that accounting could consume, across wire (Fedwire/SWIFT) and CUBIX rails. It gives no documented timing from payment to available balance and no published per-rail fees. The PYUSD 'near-instant, low to no-cost' line is marketing for the stablecoin, not platform settlement terms, and the reserve reports cover stablecoin backing, not customer statements. missing for 10: documented payment-to-available-balance timing per rail, published fee schedule per rail (wire/SWIFT/CUBIX/on-chain), downloadable statements or accounting-ready report exports, independent corroboration

support.subject: As a finance lead, settlement is legible — documented timing from payment to available balance, published fees per rail, and statements or reports my accounting can consume

citations.quote: Reconcile transactions on the Paxos Platform. Settle USD directly to your bank account.
List all transfers, optionally filtering and paging the results.
The Fiat Transfers API allows clients to deposit and withdraw fiat via Wire (Fedwire and SWIFT) and CUBIX networks.
